title: SLASH · The mat cutter
venue: Box 4B · sixty pages · never lettered for print
logline: The frame shop at 2 AM and someone in it: the green coat at the counter with the framer's mat cutter in her hand, the blade out, cutting not a mat but the photograph — into a rectangle the size of a card. The framer in the doorway. She doesn't turn. The rain does its hatching.

panels.composition: Full page: the frame shop at night, rain hatched in the window, a woman in a green coat at the counter cutting a photograph with a mat cutter's blade into a small rectangle, the framer's silhouette in the back doorway, the blade catching the streetlight.

balloons.text: I said to. I didn't say to remember it.
